findings.title: Pause and Delete remain gated on the removed ruler data
findings.body: Grafana list rows now pass only promRule, but the Pause menu item still requires a Grafana rulerRule and Delete still requires rulerRule. Computing permissions from promRule does not remove those rendering guards, so users with update/delete permissions lose both actions in the new list. Render these actions using the Grafana identifier or load the required ruler data on demand.

findings.title: Silence action does nothing for Prometheus-only Grafana rows
findings.body: The new GrafanaRuleListItem supplies promRule without rule, and AlertRuleMenu now exposes Silence notifications for those rows. Clicking it sets showSilenceDrawer, but the drawer is still rendered only when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true. Since rule is undefined, no drawer opens. Adapt the drawer path to the Prometheus rule or fetch the ruler rule when the action is selected.

findings.title: skipToken still grants Grafana duplication abilities
findings.body: skipToken is converted to undefined, but useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined) marks Duplicate supported once loading is false and grants it to users with Grafana rule-create permission. AlertRuleMenu calls this hook with skipToken for data-source rules and ORs its result with ruler abilities. Consequently external rules can show Duplicate even when their ruler does not support it, the user lacks external write permission, or the rule is plugin-provided. Skipped rules should return disabled abilities rather than abilities for a nonexistent Grafana rule.

findings.title: Preserve federated-group immutability in CombinedRule abilities
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities previously checked isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group), disabling update and delete for federated Mimir groups. Delegating directly to useAllRulerRuleAbilities discards the group and uses its hard-coded isFederated=false instead. Existing consumers of the CombinedRule hook therefore expose editing and deletion for federated rules that were deliberately immutable. Preserve the group-level federation check when adapting this hook.
